course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: An amateur gardener with training in botany is experimenting with scientific cross pollinations (17) of pink irises with red, orange, and white irises. His annual experiments show that pink can produce 60% pink and 40% white, red can produce 40% red, 50% pink, and 10% orange, orange can produce 25% orange, 50% pink, and 25% white, and white can produce 50% pink and 50% white.
i) If the gardener started with equal number of each type iris, what would the distribution be in the long run?
ii) How many years on the average would a red iris take to produce a white bloom?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
